scope: Equiangular nondegenerate triangles have proportional corresponding actual positive side lengths. Neither the similar-triangle predicate nor squared distances alone may assume the intended side-ratio conclusion.

Repeat with the remaining angle pair to cover all three corresponding sides.
Convert equal squared products to equal products of positive segment lengths, then quotients and equimultiple comparisons.

No separate Book V magnitude model
